title: rhododendron viscosum f. glaucum
intro: Rhododendron viscosum f. glaucum, commonly known as the sticky azalea, is a fragrant, flowering plant native to eastern North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron viscosum f. glaucum include its ability to stimulate the respiratory system, promote sweating, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and eliminating excess fluids. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
